statements.chinese: 嘿 Joey！

statements.english: That uh , that my sweatshirt ?
statements.chinese: 那个呃，那是我的运动衫吗？

statements.english: Oh yes , it is . I'm sorry I borrowed it , I was cold
statements.chinese: 哦，确实如此。很抱歉我借走了它，我当时觉得冷。

statements.english: I hope its okay ?
statements.chinese: 我希望这没问题？

statements.english: Well uh , it's just that uh , y'know ifif you're gonna be wearing someone's sweatshirt
statements.chinese: 呃，就是那个，你知道的，如果你要穿别人的运动衫

statements.english: shouldn't it be your boyfriends–
statements.chinese: 不该是你男朋友的——

statements.english: and I'm not him
statements.chinese: 而我并不是他。

statements.english: I'm sorry , I'll give it back to you
statements.chinese: 对不起，我会把它还给你的。

statements.english: No-no ! No ! I mean it's gonna be all smelling like Monica !
statements.chinese: 不行不行！绝对不行！我是说整个地方都会闻起来像Monica的味道！

statements.english: Are you saying I smell bad ?
statements.chinese: 你是说我身上有异味吗？

statements.english: No ! No , you smell like a meadow
statements.chinese: 不！不行，你闻起来像片草地。

statements.english: I'm sorry
statements.chinese: 对不起。

statements.english: What's with him ?
statements.chinese: 他怎么了？

statements.english: Oh , y'know what ? The last time Joey went to a meadow
statements.chinese: 哦，你知道吗？上次Joey去草地的时候，

statements.english: his mother was shot by a hunter
statements.chinese: 他的母亲被猎人枪杀了。

was.definition: be（过去式）: 构成被动语态

statements.english: Yeah , I still don't know
statements.chinese: 是啊，我还是不知道。

statements.english: I'm sorry I just wanna make sure that I bought the right couch
statements.chinese: 抱歉，我只是想确认我买对了沙发。

statements.english: I need a couch that says
statements.chinese: 我需要一张沙发，能传达出这样的感觉：

that.definition: 那个（关系代词的作用说明）

statements.english: " Kids welcome here ."
statements.chinese: "这里欢迎孩子们"

statements.english: But that also says ," Come here to me !"
statements.chinese: 但这也意味着，“到我这儿来！”

statements.english: What ?! You say that to kids ?!!
statements.chinese: 什么？！你居然对孩子们说这种话？！

statements.english: No ! No ! No ! The " Come here to me " is y'know for the ladies
statements.chinese: 不！不！不！那个‘来我这儿’的招呼，你懂的，是专门对女士们说的。

statements.english: Ross , honey , it's a nice couch . It's not a magic couch
statements.chinese: Ross，亲爱的，这沙发是不错，但又不是什么神奇沙发。

statements.english: You picked a great couch
statements.chinese: 你选的沙发真不错。

statements.english: Yeah ?
statements.chinese: 嗯？

statements.english: Yeah . Could you just sign right here please ?
statements.chinese: 好的，请您在这里签名好吗？

statements.english: Oh , sure
statements.chinese: 哦，当然。

statements.english: Whoa-whoa , what's this ?
statements.chinese: 哇哦，这是什么？

statements.english: The delivery charge is almost as much as the couch !
statements.chinese: 运费都快赶上沙发的价格了！

is.definition: be（现在时第三人称单数）: 是

statements.english: Wait ! No , that's ridiculous
statements.chinese: 等等！不，这也太荒谬了。

statements.english: Come on , he lives three blocks away !
statements.chinese: 拜托，他就住在三个街区之外！

lives.definition: live（第三人称单数）: 居住

statements.english: Yeah , y'know what ? I'll take it myself , thank you !
statements.chinese: 你知道吗？还是我自己来吧，谢谢！

statements.english: - All right Rach , come on , let's go ! - Yeah !
statements.chinese: 好了Rach，快点，我们走吧！——好！

statements.english: Are you kiddin'?
statements.chinese: 你在开玩笑吗？

statements.english: Oh , come on it's only three blocks !
statements.chinese: 哎呀，就三个街区而已！

statements.english: And-and , it's not very heavy , try it ! Come on ! Come on !
statements.chinese: 而且——而且它一点也不重，试试看嘛！快点！快点！

statements.english: Oh . Oh ! I can do it !
statements.chinese: 哦。哦！我能做到！

statements.english: You two are really gonna enjoy that couch
statements.chinese: 你们两个肯定会喜欢那张沙发的。

are.definition: are（现在时）: 构成现在进行时

statements.english: Oh yeah , we're uh , yeah we're not together
statements.chinese: 哦对了，我们呃，其实已经分手了。

statements.english: Ohh , okay . Something didn't quite add up there
statements.chinese: 哦，好吧。刚才有些地方不太对劲。

statements.english: Ross !
statements.chinese: Ross！

statements.english: - What's that supposed to mean ? - Ross !
statements.chinese: 你这话是什么意思？- Ross！

statements.english: Well you , her
statements.chinese: 好吧，你，她

statements.english: I mean , she's very ... y'know
statements.chinese: 我是说，她非常...你懂的。

statements.english: And you're like ... y'know
statements.chinese: 而你就像...你懂的。

statements.english: Not that it's any of your business , but we did go out
statements.chinese: 虽然这不关你的事，但我们确实约会过。

did.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问或强调

statements.english: - Really ? You two ? - Yeah ! Rach ?
statements.chinese: - 真的吗？你们俩？ - 是啊！Rach？

statements.english: Come on , I don't really want to be doing this right now
statements.chinese: 拜托，我现在真的不想做这个。

statements.english: I am carrying a very heavy couch
statements.chinese: 我正搬着一张非常重的长沙发。
